note: The camping area of the Piney Mountain ATV trailhead. A long gravel parking lot (about 130 m by 40 m on imagery) sits just off paved Bendersville Road, and the campsites are signed sections around an open field behind it, with a vault toilet close by; DCNR's map data says 'ATV Trail Parking Area. Camping available in back grassy lot', while the booking page lists gravel driveways. Open and in full sun. This is one of the two access points for the Michaux ATV trail, which runs from the Friday before Memorial Day to the last Sunday in September and again for part of the winter, so expect trailers, unloading and engine noise on riding days; riders, horse campers and other trail users share the lot. One of the four Michaux areas kept open through the winter camping season; forest roads get no winter maintenance. Pack out trash. --Claude

flags: DROP CANDIDATE under the off-road rule (off-road parks and OHV staging camps are out; a general campground with an OHV side stays). Evidence: DCNR's ATV page, 'Trails can be accessed from the Big Flat Parking Area (1975 Birch Run Road, Biglerville PA 17307) and the Piney Mountain Parking Area (1721 Bendersville Road, Gardeners, PA 17324)'; the ATV trail map, 'Motorized camping is available at both Piney Mountain and Big Flat parking areas'; DCNR GIS notes on each 002 site, 'ATV Trail Parking Area. Camping available in back grassy lot'. Against a drop: the sites are sold to anyone as ordinary RV/Tent/Trailer sites with no ATV-only or seasonal-use wording ('Suitable for camping with horses ... Other forest users may be encountered'), the camping field is set apart from the unloading lot, and the trail is closed from October to mid-December. Big Flat Parking Area (id 73), the other ATV trailhead, is the same kind of place and is in the database, so the two should be decided together. Owner's call.
